item.title: Medvedev rides dominant serve past Rublev for Hangzhou crown
item.description: Daniil Medvedev strengthened his bid for a return to the ATP Finals by beating fellow Russian Andrey Rublev 7-5 6-4 to win the Hangzhou Open title on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Daniil Medvedev strengthened his bid for a return to the ATP Finals by beating fellow Russian Andrey Rublev 7-5 6-4 to win the Hangzhou Open title on Tuesday. The top seed claimed his third title of the season after Brisbane and Dubai, producing a dominant display on serve with 23 aces and only two double faults in the 93-minute final. The victory also marked Medvedev's 24th career tour-level title and his 22nd on hard court. "I'm really happy to see you in this final," Medvedev said to Rublev at the trophy ceremony. "Sorry that I served good today, but hopefully we can finish the season this strong." The title win keeps the 30-year-old well placed in contention for securing a return to the season-ending event in Turin. The former world number one missed out on ATP Finals qualification last year for the first time since 2018. Medvedev, the world number six, will now head to Beijing, where he faces qualifier Pablo Carreno Busta in the first round.

item.title: US job openings fall in August; layoffs remain low
item.description: US job openings fell in August, but layoffs remained low, pointing to a stable labor market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US job openings fell in August, but layoffs remained low, pointing to a stable labor market. Job openings, a measure of labor demand, had dropped by 256,000 to 7.079 million by the last day of August, the Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics said in its Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, or JOLTS report, on Tuesday. Data for July was revised higher to show 7.335 million vacancies instead of the previously reported 7.271 million. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast 7.225 million open positions in August. The job openings rate fell to 4.3% from 4.4% in July. The JOLTS report has been plagued by a low response rate, which has decreased considerably from prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, a concern among some economists. Most view the labor market as having regained its footing after struggling through much of the summer. Nonfarm payrolls increased by 162,000 jobs in August, the most in five months. A Reuters survey of economists expects nonfarm payrolls to have advanced by 90,000 in September, with the unemployment rate forecast to have held steady at 4.1%. September's employment report will be published on Friday. Labor market stability gives the Federal Reserve scope to focus on inflation. The U.S. central bank this month raised its overnight benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range, the first hike in three years, and flagged further increases in borrowing costs in the months ahead. Financial markets are pricing in a roughly 70.3% chance of another rate increase in October, CME's FedWatch tool showed. Hiring rose 46,000 to 5.192 million. The hires rate increased to 3.3% from 3.2% in July. Layoffs and discharges dropped by 61,000 to 1.641 million, with the rate dipping to 1.0% from 1.1% in July. Historically low layoffs are mostly driving labor market stability, with employers reluctant to ramp up hiring. Economists blamed uncertainty from the US-Israeli war with Iran, which has boosted energy prices and driven up inflation. Diesel prices have surged to record highs and economists have warned it will undercut the economy.

item.title: España prevé normas más estrictas para los solicitantes de asilo en Ceuta: proyecto de decreto
item.description: España tiene previsto eludir los procedimientos habituales de inmigración y endurecer las normas sobre la solicitud de asilo para los que llegaron a su enclave norteafricano de Ceuta durante la llegada masiva de julio, según un borrador de decreto al que tuvo acceso Reuters, lo que ha provocado la indignación de expertos jurídicos y ONG.
item.dc:creator: Victoria Waldersee, Corina Pons
item.content:encoded: España tiene previsto eludir los procedimientos habituales de inmigración y endurecer las normas sobre la solicitud de asilo para los que llegaron a su enclave norteafricano de Ceuta durante la llegada masiva de julio, según un borrador de decreto al que tuvo acceso Reuters, lo que ha provocado la indignación de expertos jurídicos y ONG. El decreto, diseñado para acelerar las solicitudes y las deportaciones de los más de 10.000 migrantes que siguen en el pequeño territorio, supondría un importante giro estratégico para el Gobierno español —de izquierdas y proinmigración, firme defensor de las normas e instituciones multilaterales—, en un esfuerzo por contener las repercusiones políticas de la crisis fronteriza. El Ministerio del Interior declinó hacer comentarios sobre el borrador. Más de 70.000 personas cruzaron ilegalmente la frontera desde Marruecos hacia Ceuta por tierra y mar a fines de julio en una oleada sin precedentes, lo que impactó a los líderes europeos y puso de manifiesto los límites de una reciente reforma de las normas migratorias destinada a reforzar las fronteras. Según las medidas del borrador, filtrado por primera vez al diario El País y aún sin confirmar, los migrantes que recurran una solicitud de asilo denegada deberán hacerlo desde fuera del país si la Unión Europea lo considera seguro, como es el caso de Marruecos, independientemente de sus circunstancias personales. El decreto, que se aplicaría con carácter retroactivo a los llegados desde el cruce masivo de los días 30 y 31 de julio, también permite al Gobierno prescindir de la revisión estandarizada de las solicitudes de asilo por parte de una comisión en la que participan representantes de la Agencia de la ONU para los Refugiados. Las solicitudes de los inmigrantes se darían por retiradas si no se pudiera contactar con ellos durante cinco días, y a cualquier persona cuyo comportamiento se considerara "violento o amenazante" se le revocaría de inmediato su derecho a permanecer en el país. Abogados y ONG españolas condenaron el proyecto en declaraciones a Reuters y otros medios. Trece ONG, entre ellas la Comisión Española de Ayuda al Refugiado (CEAR) y Oxfam, las calificaron de "grave amenaza" para el compromiso de España con las convenciones de derechos humanos.

item.title: RTX's Collins Aerospace to expand Iowa plant that makes engine components
item.description: RTX said on Tuesday that its aerospace and defense systems unit, Collins Aerospace, will expand its aircraft engine components facility in West Des Moines, Iowa, by 14,000 square feet to increase manufacturing capacity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: RTX (RTX.N) said on Tuesday that its aerospace and defense systems unit, Collins Aerospace, will expand its aircraft engine components facility in West Des Moines, Iowa, by 14,000 square feet to increase manufacturing capacity. RTX said it would make a multi-million-dollar investment in the plant to meet rising customer demand. It did not disclose the exact figure The West Des Moines facility produces fuel distribution systems and engine nozzle components for commercial and military aircraft. It ships more than 25,000 engine nozzles a month The site employs about 300 full-time workers. The company plans to add more jobs by the end of the year and continue hiring into 2027 Construction is scheduled to begin later this month and completion is expected by the middle of next year Collins Aerospace completed a $14 million, 9,000-square-foot expansion of another West Des Moines facility in 2023 to increase manufacturing capacity with metal 3D printers The Arlington, Virginia-based RTX makes aircraft engines, missile systems and air-defense technologies for commercial and military customers

item.title: Rooney opposes stripping Man City's league titles over financial breaches
item.description: Wayne Rooney does not want Manchester City to be stripped of the 2011-12 Premier League title as punishment for their breaches of the competition's financial rules, believing it would be unfair for the players and staff who worked hard to win the league.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Wayne Rooney does not want Manchester City to be stripped of the 2011-12 Premier League title as punishment for their breaches of the competition's financial rules, believing it would be unfair for the players and staff who worked hard to win the league. Rooney was in the Manchester United squad that lost out by goal difference as City won their first English top-flight title in over four decades with a [USN:BRE84D0BS TEXT:"stoppage-time comeback"]. But after City were [USN:L1N45H0FI TEXT:"found guilty"] on 114 of 115 charges, they are [USN:L6N45K0U6 TEXT:"facing severe potential sanctions"] including relegation and loss of titles, although enforcement is far off with the club expected to appeal. City have consistently denied wrongdoing. Rooney's former teammates Rio Ferdinand and David de Gea suggested they should be awarded the retrospective title in social media posts, but Rooney told the "Stick to United" podcast that United did not earn it. "I wouldn't feel comfortable about accepting another Premier League medal if I'm being honest, because I don't think we deserve it. We didn't do enough that season to win the league," Rooney said in an interview released on Tuesday. "I'm thinking as their players, they're there doing everything they can to win the Premier League title and in their minds they've done it. "And, if those players have got no understanding of what's going on above them, then if that happened to me, if all of a sudden Manchester United have been doing the same and I'm getting my Premier League medals taken away from me, I'd be absolutely devastated." The former England forward, however, was in favour of City receiving a harsh punishment, including relegation and financial restrictions. "I'd put them in the lowest league they can go in and then put restrictions on them in terms of how much money they can spend for the next three or four seasons," he said.

item.title: BNP Paribas et la BEI mettent €700 mlns de garanties à disposition des réseaux énergétiques européens
item.description: BNP Paribas et la Banque européenne d'investissement (BEI) ont annoncé mardi mettre 700 millions d'euros de garanties à disposition des réseaux énergétiques européens, afin de soutenir leur transition énergétique, renforcer la compétitivité industrielle et sécuriser l'approvisionnement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) et la Banque européenne d'investissement (BEI) ont annoncé mardi mettre 700 millions d'euros de garanties à disposition des réseaux énergétiques européens, afin de soutenir leur transition énergétique, renforcer la compétitivité industrielle et sécuriser l'approvisionnement. "Cette opération de partage de risque vise à accroître la capacité de BNP Paribas à s'engager en faveur des fabricants européens de composants pour les réseaux électriques et à leur permettre de répondre à la forte demande générée par la transition énergétique", déclare le groupe dans un communiqué. La BEI s'engage à rendre disponible 350 millions d'euros de garantie pour constituer un portefeuille de financements destinés aux fabricants de composants pour les réseaux, selon le communiqué, BNP Paribas s'engageant pour un montant équivalent. D'après la banque française, "l'effet de levier généré par cette contre-garantie devrait stimuler jusqu'à 2,8 milliards d'euros d'investissements dans l'économie réelle".

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street sur de timides variations, la "tech" en soutien
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert sur de faibles variations mardi, le rebond des valeurs technologiques offrant un peu de soutien sur un marché prudent alors que le conflit au Moyen-Orient, les niveaux élevés des cours pétroliers et des rendements obligataires limitent l'appétit pour le risque.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert sur de faibles variations mardi, le rebond des valeurs technologiques offrant un peu de soutien sur un marché prudent alors que le conflit au Moyen-Orient, les niveaux élevés des cours pétroliers et des rendements obligataires limitent l'appétit pour le risque. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) perd 44,23 points, soit 0,09%, à 51.437,28 points. Le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, monte de 8,67 points, soit 0,11%, à 7.692,36 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) progresse de 84,22 points, soit 0,31%, à 26.904,60 points. Le compartiment technologique (.SPLRCT) est au centre de l'attention, le prospectus d'introduction en Bourse (IPO) d'[USN:L6N45L01F TEXT:"Anthropic"], consulté par Reuters, ayant montré une forte croissance du spécialiste de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) sur l'année écoulée. Anthropic vise une valorisation de plus de 2.000 milliards de dollars pour son IPO, ce qui pourrait servir de mètre-étalon au secteur. "Le marché se trouve actuellement dans une phase d'observation. La croissance des bénéfices a été phénoménale, mais les attentes sont extrêmement élevées et une grande partie des bonnes nouvelles sont déjà intégrées au cours des actions", note Newton Jones, directeur général exécutif du groupe Zizmer-Jones Private Wealth Management. Les groupes liés aux semi-conducteurs comme Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) , Micron Technology (MU.O) et Broadcom (AVGO.O) avancent de 1,88% à 2,82% après de fortes baisses la veille. Le secteur des puces (.SOX) s'adjuge 1,66%. Nvidia (NVDA.O) , qui a pris 1,68% lundi, monte encore, de 1,42%, restant sur la lancée positive de la veille après que le spécialiste des puces a dévoilé un programme de rachat d'actions record de 150 milliards de dollars. Dans les indicateurs américains du jour susceptibles d'influer sur la tendance figurent l'enquête JOLTS sur les offres d'emplois, prélude au rapport mensuel officiel sur l'emploi, prévu vendredi, ainsi qu'un indice mesurant la confiance du consommateur pour le mois de septembre. Ces données sont importantes alors que la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed), à l'initiative de son nouveau président Kevin Warsh, a opté pour une réduction de sa communication sur ses orientations prospectives. Selon le baromètre CME FedWatch, les opérateurs tablent actuellement avec une probabilité de 70% la probabilité sur une nouvelle hausse des taux de la Fed en octobre. Au moins six responsables de la banque centrale américaine, dont le président de la Fed de New York, John Williams, doivent s'exprimer ce mardi. Pour le moment, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans recule de 1,4 point de base, à 5,229%, après cinq séances consécutives de gains, ce qui soulage le marché actions. Les cours pétroliers refluent également, aidés par des signes d'une reprise des exportations de brut en provenance du Moyen-Orient. Le Brent et le WTI devraient toutefois enregistrer des gains mensuels d'environ 16% et 7% respectivement. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L8N45L0QY]

item.title: Falha no motor da Starship pode afetar objetivos da missão lunar da Nasa
item.description: A falha no motor da Starship, que quase impediu a estreia orbital da espaçonave de última geração da SpaceX em seu 14º voo de teste não tripulado, pode dificultar a capacidade da Nasa de cumprir seu cronograma para missões de astronautas à Lua.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman, Akash Sriram, Joey Roulette
item.content:encoded: A falha no motor da Starship, que quase impediu a estreia orbital da espaçonave de última geração da SpaceX em seu 14º voo de teste não tripulado, pode dificultar a capacidade da Nasa de cumprir seu cronograma para missões de astronautas à Lua. A Starship, projetada em parte para transportar grandes cargas úteis ao espaço, é uma das duas naves que disputam o título de primeira nave que a Nasa utilizará já em 2028 para levar seres humanos à Lua e trazê-los de volta em segurança, um feito alcançado pela última vez em 1972, no final da era Apollo. Embora a Starship tenha cumprido vários objetivos-chave em seu último lançamento de teste, realizado na segunda-feira no Texas, a missão foi encurtada em várias horas devido a uma falha em seu sistema de propulsão. Apesar da desativação inesperada de um de seus três motores Raptor principais após a separação da Starship do foguete impulsionador do estágio inferior, os controladores de voo prosseguiram com o envio da espaçonave à órbita para seu primeiro lançamento comercial de satélite. Determinar o que causou a falha no motor continua sendo fundamental para os resultados financeiros da SpaceX. Mas os riscos são potencialmente maiores para a Nasa, já que um veículo de pouso lunar da Starship dependeria do mesmo sistema de propulsão para transportar astronautas pelo espaço de e para a superfície lunar. O quanto essa falha no motor representará um revés para o progresso do desenvolvimento da Starship depende se ela for “uma falha pontual de uma única peça” ou se apontar para um problema de projeto mais amplo que exija atualizações “em toda a frota”, disse Dean Sladen, engenheiro aeroespacial da Accu Components. “Qualquer reparo no motor que atrase os próximos voos, incluindo a tentativa planejada de capturar a nave com os braços da torre de lançamento (após a reentrada), prejudica esse cronograma”, disse ele. A Nasa e a SpaceX não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário da Reuters. Um atraso mais prolongado representaria não apenas um revés maior para as ambições comerciais da SpaceX de expandir rapidamente sua rede de satélites de banda larga Starlink, mas também para seu papel fundamental no programa lunar Artemis da Nasa. “A verdadeira pressão é a Lua. A Nasa precisa da Starship para a Artemis 3”, disse Sladen, referindo-se a uma missão de teste em órbita terrestre prevista para já no próximo verão (no Hemisfério Norte) como um voo de ensaio para o primeiro pouso lunar tripulado do programa. Problemas com o motor Raptor e o sistema de propulsão contribuíram para vários contratempos anteriores da Starship, incluindo um motor que não acendeu conforme planejado durante o 12º voo da Starship, em maio. Os motores movidos a metano estão entre os componentes mais complexos e caros do foguete. Durante alguns voos anteriores, a SpaceX cancelou os planos de testar a ignição do motor Raptor no espaço. Mas todos os motores foram acionados com sucesso durante a ascensão no 13º voo da Starship, em julho. A SpaceX (SPCX.O) , empresa fundada por Elon Musk perto de Los Angeles em 2002 e que recentemente abriu seu capital, está competindo com a Blue Origin, empresa rival de foguetes do também empresário Jeff Bezos, para inaugurar uma era de exploração lunar no âmbito do programa Artemis da Nasa. Embora a SpaceX tenha sido originalmente contratada para fornecer o primeiro módulo de pouso lunar tripulado para o Artemis, o chefe da agência espacial dos EUA, Jared Isaacman, afirmou em abril que a Nasa optaria pelo módulo que estivesse pronto para voar primeiro. A Nasa considerou essa concorrência adicional saudável para o progresso, tendo em vista os crescentes atrasos no programa de voos de teste da Starship. A Nasa tem como meta oficial levar astronautas de volta à superfície da Lua até 2028 — uma meta amplamente considerada excessivamente ambiciosa — para chegar lá antes da China, que planeja um pouso tripulado na Lua até 2030. (Reportagem de Steve Gorman, em Los Angeles, e Akash Sriram, em Bengaluru; Reportagem adicional de Joey Roulette, em Washington)

item.title: Anthropic's IPO prospectus sharpens focus on AI valuations
item.description: Anthropic is betting that AI will reshape the global economy more profoundly than industrialization, electricity and the internet, according to its IPO prospectus seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic is betting that AI will reshape the global economy more profoundly than industrialization, electricity and the internet, according to its [USN:L6N45L01L TEXT:"IPO prospectus"] seen by Reuters. The AI lab, which could be valued at more than $2 trillion in its IPO, plans to spend $518 billion on cloud computing and infrastructure obligations in the coming years, according to the prospectus. European tech shares (.SX8P) jumped 2.4%, while U.S. chip index (.SOX) climbed 1.5%. Here are some comments from analysts on Anthropic's reported financials: SUSANNAH STREETER, CHIEF INVESTMENT STRATEGIST, WEALTH CLUB, LONDON "It's the vision and the projections to the extent to which Anthropic believes AI will be a game changer for economies around the world that seem to have lifted demand for European tech stocks." "There still will be niggles of concern among some about the huge sums that are projected to be spent even though it is making a loss. But that hasn't caused a flutter of general fear because, overall, there still seems to be a pretty hefty appetite for AI focused investments." MICHAEL FIELD, CHIEF EQUITY STRATEGIST, MORNINGSTAR, AMSTERDAM "If anything, the acceleration of the business is the biggest part of this release. Growing a big business can be difficult, but the prospectus stating that revenue grew by 12 fold in 2025 is truly remarkable." "Obviously a $2 trillion valuation sounds outlandish, but when you break it down to a multiple of sales, likely to be around 18-20x, it sounds much more reasonable than the recent SpaceX IPO." "The losses certainly are a concern. Particularly given the growth rate and the size relative to current revenues. It's unlikely to deter investors, however, with the spend story having been digested for some time now." "The key takeaway for investors is the confidence in the business and the AI strategy. Yes spend is high and growing, but management obviously feel the growth rate inherent in demand is sufficiently attractive to keep spending, hence why they are coming to market and demanding a top-dollar valuation." DAN COATSWORTH, HEAD OF MARKETS, AJ BELL, LONDON "Massive spending would normally have investors running for the hills, but what's capturing the market's attention is Anthropic's stellar revenue growth, up 12-fold in 2025. Admittedly, AI is moving at such a rapid pace that last year’s sales achievements relate to technology that is already outdated." "However, nearly one quarter of last year's revenue reportedly came from two customers, implying concentration risks. Investors will be hoping that it broadens its client base quickly." KATHLEEN BROOKS, RESEARCH DIRECTOR, XTB PLATFORM, LONDON "This is positive for the AI trade, since it is fuelled by continued elevated levels of capex spend. The fact that Anthropic is planning on spending big on capex means that the capex cycle is not over yet. This is good news for semiconductor and AI infrastructure companies. I believe that if Anthropic had signalled a lower level of spending, this could have caused a wobble in the AI trade, since it would lead to fears about the sustainability of the AI trade as we move into Q4." NEWTON JONES, WEALTH MANAGER, ZIZMER-JONES PRIVATE WEALTH MANAGEMENT GROUP AT STEWARD PARTNERS, WINTER PARK, FLORIDA "There are a lot of question marks around these valuations. It's hard for me to get my arms around companies that are losing billions of dollars, require massive capital expenditure and are looking at equity values of more than $2 trillion." "When you have this much money being thrown at a sector, it is driving valuations based on optimism and on what could go right. The annual recurring revenue opportunity investors see in the future is what's underpinning these valuations."

item.title: New Mexico launches quantum hub to bring together private firms with US national labs
item.description: New Mexico officials on Tuesday launched a shared quantum computing research facility to bring together the two US national labs in the state with private companies.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: New Mexico officials on Tuesday launched a shared quantum computing research facility to bring together the two US national labs in the state with private companies. The Roadrunner Quantum Lab, as it is called, is a 35,000-square-foot (3,252-square-meter) facility in Albuquerque, New Mexico, that will have features such as concrete floors several feet thick and dilution refrigerators, cryogenic cooling units that keep quantum computers so cold that atoms barely move. The outpost is the first concrete step in an effort to [USN:L6N3UL0U7 TEXT:"direct hundreds of millions of dollars into"][USN:L6N3UL0U7 TEXT:" quantum computing"], which could help solve problems that would take conventional computers thousands of years. Two of the initial tenants will be Sandia and Los Alamos National Labs, two of the three US labs that develop and maintain the nation's nuclear weapons arsenal. The labs will provide independent scientific expertise and set up a Quantum Demonstration Facility to help the private firms in the facility build and evaluate quantum systems. "The idea is to help take technology we've done at the labs, and help them commercialize and become successful companies," Rob Black, the secretary of economic development for New Mexico, said in an interview. "That's how we scale to ensure the US leads in these very important technologies." The private companies at the facility will include Diraq, IonQ (IONQ.N) , Quantum Machines, Conductor Quantum, Mesa Quantum, QBoltz, Photon Queue and QuEra. Adam Hammer, CEO of Roadrunner Venture Studios, which received state funding to lead the effort around the facility, said it was in part inspired by Taiwan's 1980s push to develop a semiconductor zone in Hsinchu County, which is now home to both Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330.TW) and United Microelectronics Corp (2303.TW) . "The Taiwanese government funded this three-mile industry zone where they put up a lot of the patient capital to create shared manufacturing facilities. And that birthed TSMC. It also birthed their biggest rival, UMC," Hammer said in an interview. "And it was a feature, not a bug, that they were building elbow to elbow."

item.title: Who is John Waldron, long seen as next Goldman CEO?
item.description: Goldman Sachs Group is reportedly laying the groundwork for a succession plan that would see President and Chief Operating Officer John Waldron succeed David Solomon as CEO as early as 2027 or 2028.
item.dc:creator: Pritam Biswas, Arasu Basil
item.content:encoded: Goldman Sachs Group (GS.N) is reportedly laying the groundwork for a [USN:L4N45K1NY TEXT:"succession plan"] that would see President and Chief Operating Officer John Waldron succeed David Solomon as CEO as early as 2027 or 2028. If finalized, the transition would crown a nearly three-decade career at the Wall Street giant for the 57-year-old executive, who has worked in lockstep with Solomon to engineer the firm's modern strategic direction. Here are key facts about Waldron’s life, career and role at the bank: EARLY LIFE AND EDUCATION Waldron was raised in Cleveland, Ohio, before his family relocated to Philadelphia when he was 15. He earned a Bachelor of Arts degree from Middlebury College in Vermont. A former youth athlete, Waldron often credits his early sports experiences for teaching him discipline, the value of constructive feedback, and the importance of methodically improving upon his weaknesses. CLIMBING THE WALL STREET LADDER Like Solomon, Waldron spent part of his early career at Bear Stearns. He joined Goldman Sachs in 2000, roughly a year after Solomon's arrival. In an interview recently, Waldron shared that Goldman Sachs had initially rejected him as he failed a financial modelling test due to weak mathametics and accounting skills. Waldron steadily advanced through Goldman's investment banking divisions. He served as co-head of leveraged finance and held several positions of increasing seniority between 2000 to 2007, followed by a stint as global co-head of the financial sponsors group from 2007 to 2009. He served as global head of investment banking services and client coverage from 2009 to 2014, when he was promoted to co-head of the investment banking division, a role he held until October 2018. SOLOMON-WALDRON ERA Waldron's career trajectory has closely mirrored Solomon's. In October 2018, the exact month Solomon was named CEO, Waldron was elevated to president and chief operating officer at Goldman Sachs. In January 2025, both executives were awarded massive $80 million retention bonuses in restricted stock. The following month, Waldron was officially added to Goldman Sachs' board of directors, a move analysts viewed as cementing his status as the heir apparent. The move came a few months after he was reportedly approached by alternative asset manager Apollo, which he declined. Industry analysts have also noted that Waldron and Solomon have driven Goldman's current priorities together. Waldron is widely expected to maintain the strategy devised under Solomon rather than implement a radical pivot. KEY INITIATIVES AND LEADERSHIP STYLE As COO, Waldron has led execution priorities and operational efficiencies. Notably, he is credited with developing "OneGS 3.0", a long-term, AI-driven transformation plan introduced in late 2025. The initiative was designed to bolster the bank's resilience, productivity and profitability through automation, alongside capping headcount growth. He serves as co-chair of the firmwide enterprise risk committee, giving him broad oversight of Goldman's financial and nonfinancial risk management. Waldron is known for a disciplined, highly organized leadership style - famously color-coding his calendar to strictly separate business from family time - something he said in a conversation with BYU Marriott dean Brigitte Madrian. Waldron is married and has six kids. EXTERNAL EFFORTS Beyond Goldman, Waldron is chair of the International Advisory Board of the Atlantic Council and a member of the board of directors for the US-China Business Council. He also sits on the boards of the Cleveland Clinic, the Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts and the board of trustees at Middlebury College.

item.title: 'Let them be scared': Moscow sends EU message with widening corporate crackdown
item.description: Russia has singled out European firms in its latest drive to strip foreign owners of the right to manage their Russian assets, government and company sources said, with the Kremlin accusing the European Union of involvement in the war in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia has singled out European firms in its latest drive to strip foreign owners of the right to manage their Russian assets, government and company sources said, with the Kremlin accusing the European Union of involvement in the war in Ukraine . Russia [USN:L6N45K0RX TEXT:"placed"] the assets of Swiss food giant Nestle, German wholesaler Metro AG and French retailer Auchan under temporary management this month. "The time has come for asymmetric measures. Let them think about what measures they are taking and what sanctions they are introducing," a senior government source with direct knowledge of the measures told Reuters. Asked which companies might be the next targets and whether the Russian units of Italian bank UniCredit and Austrian lender Raiffeisen could be placed under temporary management, the source, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said: "Let them be scared." A Russian corporate source, who also spoke on condition of anonymity, accused European firms of deliberately stifling the development of their Russian units, ultimately harming the Russian economy. A senior manager with a European company, part of a shrinking community of foreign businesses operating in Russia, told Reuters that European businesses expected the status quo to be maintained in the immediate future. The Kremlin said on Tuesday the decisions were driven by "the increasing level of involvement of these unfriendly countries in direct battlefield hostilities" against Russia, but suggested the moves were "reversible". "For now, we do not see any grounds for a reversal. We do not hear any reasonable voices calling for dialogue or for efforts to rectify the situation," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters. The EU blames Russia for the failure to end the war, saying Moscow shows no real intent to engage in genuine peace talks, and last week [USN:L6N45F0S1 TEXT:"renewed sanctions"] on more than 3,000 individuals and entities. It did not immediately comment on Russia's latest moves against European companies. WAR WAGED BY EUROPE Peskov gave no evidence or details of how European countries were involved in military operations. Russian officials have previously cited weapons supplies, including the manufacture of drones in the EU, as well as the provision of targeting and intelligence information. "If you acknowledge that your weapons are being used against us, and we are shooting them down, call it whatever you want, but I have no doubt that this is a war being waged against us by Europe," Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said on Tuesday. Russia also criticises the EU for [USN:L6N3XO0R3 TEXT:"freezing"] about €210 billion ($238 billion) of its sovereign assets in response to the war and for targeting assets belonging to Russian companies in Europe and other Western countries. The EU, a staunch supporter of Ukraine during the more than 4-1/2-year-old war, has accused Russia of carrying out attacks on European territory, while some government and intelligence officials have raised the prospect of a future Russian invasion. Moscow has denied the accusations. Since the start of the war, Russia has introduced temporary administration at 135 firms affiliated with foreign companies, the vast majority of them from EU countries, including French food group Danone and Danish brewer Carlsberg, according to data compiled by Russian news agency TASS. Prior to the latest moves, Russian law firm NSP put the number of affected Western firms at 22. In its latest annual report, the Association of European Businesses said it had 330 member companies with operations in Russia, down from 400 a year earlier. No major US company has been targeted by similar measures, although some smaller firms, such as US private equity fund NCH Capital, whose Russian business includes agricultural assets, have also been [USN:L6N3YL0V9 TEXT:"placed"] under temporary administration. The American Chamber of Commerce in Russia put the number of US companies still operating in Russia at around 300 this year. Russia and the United States have been in discussions on business opportunities once peace is restored in Ukraine. ($1 = 0.8814 euros)

item.title: Florence Pugh diz que série “A Leste do Éden” revela lado humano de Cathy
item.description: Florence Pugh afirma que a nova adaptação de “A Leste do Éden” convida o público a ver Cathy, uma das vilãs mais notórias da literatura norte-americana, sob uma perspectiva mais compreensiva.
item.dc:creator: Francesca Halliwell
item.content:encoded: Florence Pugh afirma que a nova adaptação de “A Leste do Éden” convida o público a ver Cathy, uma das vilãs mais notórias da literatura norte-americana, sob uma perspectiva mais compreensiva. A atriz, que interpreta Cathy na minissérie de sete episódios, disse que a adaptação acrescenta contexto a uma personagem que o autor John Steinbeck descreveu famosamente como um “monstro psíquico” com uma “alma deformada”. “Ela ainda pode tomar decisões terríveis e enfrentar consequências horríveis, mas também pode haver... uma compreensão de sua história e de seu passado que a tornam do jeito que ela é”, disse a indicada ao Oscar. Escrita por Zoe Kazan, que coproduz a série ao lado de Jeb Stuart, a adaptação revisita a saga multigeracional de Steinbeck, com um foco renovado em Cathy. Kazan disse que a adaptação desafia os espectadores a enxergarem além das noções simplistas de bem e mal. “Queríamos que nosso público pudesse se identificar com cada personagem, tanto aqueles que parecem bons quanto aqueles que parecem maus”, disse ela. “Porque, se pensarmos nas pessoas que são más ou ruins como se não fossem humanas, não aprendemos nada sobre nós mesmos.” Kazan afirmou que sente uma profunda conexão com “A Leste do Éden” desde que leu o romance aos 15 anos, descrevendo-o como uma história que “me agarrou pela garganta e não me soltou” com sua exploração de como as pessoas carregam o passado de suas famílias para o futuro. Questionada se o foco do romance na herança e no acerto de contas com o passado ressoava pessoalmente nela, Kazan citou sua própria história familiar. Seu avô, o cineasta Elia Kazan, continua sendo uma figura controversa após ter denunciado ex-colegas ligados ao Partido Comunista perante uma comissão do Congresso durante a era McCarthy. Ele também dirigiu a adaptação do romance para o cinema em 1955, estrelada por James Dean. Descrevendo sua conexão com o material tanto como “fardo” quanto como “presente”, Kazan disse que espera que a série leve o público a refletir sobre suas próprias famílias, e não sobre a dela. “Não quero que ninguém saia daqui pensando: ‘Zoe Kazan, Elia Kazan’”, afirmou. “Queremos que as pessoas saiam daqui (pensando)... ‘Meu pai, meu filho, as coisas que eu fiz’.” Para Mike Faist, astro de “Rivais”, que interpreta Charles Trask na série, a história de Steinbeck perdurou porque reflete verdades fundamentais sobre a moralidade humana. “Voltamos a esses clássicos para... reexaminá-los, e isso é algo positivo”, disse ele. Stuart concordou com Faist, dizendo que os leitores podem voltar a “A Leste do Éden” ao longo de suas vidas e descobrir novos significados à medida que suas próprias experiências evoluem. “Perdi um filho adulto, então, mais tarde na vida... li o livro como se nunca tivesse lido ‘A Leste do Éden’ antes”, disse ele à Reuters. “Isso é o que há de mais legal na escrita de Steinbeck.” “A Leste do Éden” será lançada na Netflix na quinta-feira.

item.title: Geopark invertirá 7.000 millones de dólares para elevar la producción de campo petrolífero venezolano a 90.000 barriles diarios
item.description: La petrolera y gasífera colombiana Geopark planea una inversión de 7.000 millones de dólares en vasto yacimiento petrolífero venezolano de Bare para aumentar la producción de crudo allí a unos 90.000 barriles diarios (bpd) para el año 2038, frente a los 11.000 actuales, dijo el martes el director ejecutivo de la firma Felipe Bayón.
item.dc:creator: Deisy Buitrago
item.content:encoded: La petrolera y gasífera colombiana Geopark planea una inversión de 7.000 millones de dólares en vasto yacimiento petrolífero venezolano de Bare para aumentar la producción de crudo allí a unos 90.000 barriles diarios (bpd) para el año 2038, frente a los 11.000 actuales, dijo el martes el director ejecutivo de la firma Felipe Bayón. La compañía planea comenzar las operaciones en diciembre. Con un volumen total de petróleo in situ de 15.700 millones de barriles, Bare supondrá la entrada de GeoPark (GPRK.N) en Venezuela, tras la firma de un acuerdo de producción compartida a 25 años con el gobierno a principios de este mes. La empresa tiene previsto iniciar operaciones en la zona de la Faja del Orinoco en diciembre. "Es una inversión muy relevante" en términos de capital y gastos para maximizar la recuperación de la producción, afirmó Bayón el lunes durante la Cumbre Internacional de Petróleo y Gas de Venezuela (VIOGS) que se realiza en Caracas, añadiendo que se reactivarán hasta 1.100 pozos y que posteriormente podrían perforarse unos 80 nuevos pozos horizontales. Se espera que el inventario de pozos existentes y la infraestructura instalada en Bare permitan llevar a cabo un proyecto de desarrollo dividido en cuatro fases, agregó el ejecutivo. En un comunicado emitido a principios de este mes, GeoPark informó que disponía de unos 700 millones de dólares en liquidez y fuentes de financiación comprometidas para cubrir la inversión inicial, incluidos 310 millones de dólares en efectivo. La operación en Venezuela se financió con capital propio de GeoPark y se prevé que resulte en la adquisición indirecta del control de GeoPark por parte del Grupo Gilinski, de Colombia. GeoPark considera a Bare un paso clave en su estrategia regional a largo plazo, complementando sus proyectos en Colombia y Argentina. "Se espera que la incorporación de Bare y el aumento de la producción en Vaca Muerta (Argentina) incrementen potencialmente la producción de GeoPark hasta situarla entre 75.000 y 85.000 barriles equivalentes de petróleo diarios para 2030, lo que supone aproximadamente 2,7 veces los niveles de producción actuales", señaló la empresa en el comunicado.

item.title: Carnival raises annual profit forecast on strong demand
item.description: Cruise operator Carnival Corp raised its annual profit forecast on Tuesday and pointed to record 2027 bookings, signaling sustained demand despite geopolitical uncertainty and sending its shares up nearly 12%.
item.dc:creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
item.content:encoded: Cruise operator Carnival Corp (CCL.N) raised its annual profit forecast on Tuesday and pointed to record 2027 bookings, signaling sustained demand despite geopolitical uncertainty and sending its shares up nearly 12%. The company has been benefiting from affluent travelers who continue to prioritize experiences, particularly sea voyages and bucket-list adventures, even as the ongoing Middle East conflict clouds the economic outlook. Carnival, which is the only major US cruise line that typically does not hedge fuel, raised its full-year profit target by more than $150 million from its June forecast, helped by stronger pricing, lower operating costs and improved fuel efficiency that offset higher fuel prices. The company now expects 2026 adjusted earnings of about $2.24 per share, up from $2.22 previously. Carnival said it was already about half booked for 2027, with both occupancy and pricing at record levels, while bookings for 2028 were off to "an excellent start." "Consumers are prioritizing travel and experiences, even as they become more selective," said Consumer Edge analyst Michael Gunther. Older and wealthier travelers, who make up a large share of the customer base for Princess and Holland America brands, could provide an additional boost to demand, he added. Cruise operators, heavily dependent on fuel oil and marine gas oil, have been navigating a tougher environment as the prolonged US-Iran war has heightened concerns over potential supply disruptions. Most cruise companies have increased ticket prices and are also offering new attractions and fun activities on a budget to attract more customers. Shares of Royal Caribbean (RCL.N) jumped 6%, while those of Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH.N) rose 5% after Carnival beat third-quarter estimates. Carnival reported revenue of $8.44 billion for the quarter ended August 31, compared with analysts' average estimate of $8.30 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. On an adjusted basis, it posted a quarterly profit of $1.43 per share, compared with analysts' average estimate of $1.36.

item.title: Siemens nach "solidem" Quartal zuversichtlich für Ziele
item.description: Der Münchner Technologiekonzern Siemens sieht sich angesichts eines leichten konjunkturellen Rückenwindes auf Kurs zu seinen Jahreszielen. Der Geschäftsverlauf im vierten Quartal sei "bisher solide", sagte die neue Siemens-Finanzvorständin Veronika Bienert der "Börsen-Zeitung" in einem am Dienstag veröffentlichten Interview. "Ich bin zuversichtlich, dass wir unsere Ziele erreichen werden, so wie wir sie dem Kapitalmarkt avisiert haben." Siemens hatte im Sommer für das am Mittwoch endende Geschäftsjahr 2025/26 einen Gewinn je Aktie von 11,20 bis 11,50 Euro in Aussicht gestellt. Der Umsatz soll vergleichbar gerechnet um sieben bis acht Prozent zulegen. "Es gibt, soweit wir das bisher überblicken, keine Überraschungen", sagte Bienert.

Der Geschäftsverlauf im vierten Quartal sei "bisher solide", sagte die neue Siemens-Finanzvorständin Veronika Bienert der "Börsen-Zeitung" in einem am Dienstag veröffentlichten Interview. "Ich bin zuversichtlich, dass wir unsere Ziele erreichen werden, so wie wir sie dem Kapitalmarkt avisiert haben." Siemens hatte im Sommer für das am Mittwoch endende Geschäftsjahr 2025/26 einen Gewinn je Aktie von 11,20 bis 11,50 Euro in Aussicht gestellt. Der Umsatz soll vergleichbar gerechnet um sieben bis acht Prozent zulegen. "Es gibt, soweit wir das bisher überblicken, keine Überraschungen", sagte Bienert. "Wir sehen eine leichte Verbesserung der wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen wir agieren", sagte die seit dem Frühjahr amtierende Finanzchefin. Branchen wie Halbleiter, Luftfahrt oder Verteidigung zeigten ein überproportionales Wachstum. Zwar sei die Nachfrage aus der Automobilindustrie gedämpft, und es gebe eine Investitionszurückhaltung in energieintensiven Branchen wie der Chemie. "Aber insgesamt geht es eher aufwärts." In China gewinne das Geschäft mit der Automatisierung, das vorübergehend geschwächelt hatte, wieder an Schwung, sagte Bienert. Es gebe keine Anzeichen dafür, dass Siemens in China Marktanteile verliere. Das Softwaregeschäft der Automatisierungs-Sparte Digital Industries profitiere von der Eingliederung der beiden Milliarden-Zukäufe in den USA, Altair und Dotmatics, und vom höheren Anteil des Abonnement-Geschäfts mit Software. Laut Bienert dürfen die Siemens-Aktionäre darauf hoffen, bis Mai 2027 Aktien der bisherigen Medizintechnik-Tochter Siemens Healthineers (SHLG.DE) in die Depots gebucht zu bekommen. Die beiden Hauptversammlungen sollen im Februar nächsten Jahres über die Abspaltung entscheiden. "Danach könnte die Transaktion bis Mai 2027 vollzogen sein, soweit keine Anfechtungsklagen erhoben werden", sagte Bienert. Siemens hatte angekündigt, rund 30 Prozent der Siemens-Healthineers-Aktien an die eigenen Aktionäre zu übertragen und damit die Mehrheit an der Erlanger Tochter abzugeben. Bisher hält Siemens 67 Prozent. Rechnerisch würde damit jeder Siemens-Anteilseigner 2,311 Healthineers-Aktien bekommen. Bienert sagte aber, man werde auf ein "gut nachvollziehbares" Verhältnis achten.

item.title: Governo central tem déficit primário de R$13,585 bilhões em agosto, diz Tesouro
item.description: O governo central registrou um déficit primário de R$13,585 bilhões em agosto, informou o Tesouro Nacional nesta terça-feira, resultado melhor que o rombo de R$15,540 bilhões do mesmo mês do ano passado.
item.dc:creator: Fabricio Castro
item.content:encoded: O governo central registrou um déficit primário de R$13,585 bilhões em agosto, informou o Tesouro Nacional nesta terça-feira, resultado melhor que o rombo de R$15,540 bilhões do mesmo mês do ano passado. Economistas consultados pela Reuters esperavam que o dado, que compreende as contas de Tesouro, Banco Central e Previdência Social, fosse deficitário em R$14,400 bilhões no mês passado. (BRCGPB=ECI) Em julho, o resultado havia sido superavitário em R$10,803 bilhões em valores correntes e superavitário em R$10,769 bilhões considerando o ajuste pela inflação. Conforme os dados do Tesouro, a receita líquida do governo central somou em agosto R$187,878 bilhões, o que representa uma alta de 3,5% ante o mesmo mês do ano passado, em termos reais (descontada a inflação). Já a despesa total somou R$201,463 bilhões em agosto, uma elevação de 1,9%. Com o resultado, no acumulado de janeiro a agosto o governo central apresenta uma déficit primário de R$94,869 bilhões, uma elevação real de 7,1% ante o rombo de R$85,888 bilhões do mesmo período do ano passado. Durante entrevista coletiva, autoridades do Tesouro abordaram nesta terça-feira os impactos tanto nas receitas quanto nas despesas da crise do petróleo, gerada pela guerra no Oriente Médio. Além da alta da commodity, que eleva as receitas, medidas adotadas pelo governo para amenizar o impacto nos preços dos combustíveis afetam as despesas. De acordo com o secretário do Tesouro Nacional, Daniel Cardoso Leal, as receitas adicionais esperadas para o ano, considerando os impactos trazidos pelo petróleo e pelas medidas tomadas pelo governo, somam R$67,5 bilhões, mais do que compensando as despesas adicionais de R$32,4 bilhões projetadas até agora.

item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa tinha uma queda modesta nesta terça-feira, pressionado principalmente por Vale, com nova pesquisa mantendo o cenário acirrado na corrida presidencial no Brasil, que deve ser decidida apenas no segundo turno. Por volta de 11h15, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) , referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, cedia 0,28%, a 182.471,11 pontos. De acordo com pesquisa [USN:S0N45A03Q TEXT:"Atlas/Bloomberg"] divulgada nesta terça-feira, o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) lidera as intenções de voto para o primeiro turno com 45,3%, seguido por senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), que somou 42,2%. Em um potencial segundo turno, ambos permanecem em empate técnico, mas com Flávio à frente, com 47,7%, enquanto Lula teria 47,6%. "A leitura conjunta das pesquisas continua sendo de disputa muito apertada em um eventual segundo turno", disse o responsável pela área de renda variável da Criteria, Thiago Pedroso. O primeiro turno da eleição está previsto para o próximo domingo e o segundo é aguardado em 25 de outubro. A agenda macro do dia também incluía dados de[USN:AQN2MLBPV TEXT:" inflação"], [USN:L1N45L0EI TEXT:"desemprego"] e crédito no Brasil, além de números mostrando que o governo central registrou um [USN:L1N45L0HO TEXT:"déficit primário"] de R$13,585 bilhões em agosto. No exterior, os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos experimentam uma acomodação, endossada pelo alívio nos preços do petróleo, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) rondava a estabilidade. A estatal também informou nesta terça-feira ter assinado contrato de longo prazo de compra e venda de [USN:S0N43N004 TEXT:"gás natural liquefeito"] (GNL) com a Cheniere Marketing, companhia norte-americana subsidiária da Cheniere Energy. ITAÚ PN avançava 0,12%, em dia misto no setor, tendo no radar [USN:L1N45L0DJ TEXT:"dados sobre crédito"] no país. BRADESCO PN recuava 0,23% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT cedia 0,77%, enquanto BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) subia 1,35%. BTG PACTUAL UNIT operava estável, tendo ainda no radar que recebeu [USN:L6N45L0RF TEXT:"autorização"] regulatória para operar banco no Peru. CSN MINERAÇÃO ON (CMIN3.SA) recuava 3,17%. No setor, USIMINAS PNA caía 2,86% e GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) cedia 1,75%. AZZAS 2154 ON (AZZA3.SA) avançava 6,44%, em dia de ajustes após queda de mais de 5% na véspera. Investidores seguem especulando sobre potenciais reflexos da [USN:L6N44U12G TEXT:"reorganização"] societária anunciada no começo do mês, bem como de eventual transação que envolva a unidade FARM Rio.

item.title: Nigeria's Dangote says refinery IPO demand 'enormous' as Kenya project advances
item.description: Aliko Dangote said on Tuesday that investor demand for his ongoing Lagos refinery share sale was "enormous", as the Nigerian pressed ahead with plans for a $16 billion refinery in Kenya that would extend his energy empire across Africa.
item.dc:creator: Duncan Miriri
item.content:encoded: Aliko Dangote said on Tuesday that investor demand for his ongoing [USN:L1N456052 TEXT:"Lagos refinery share sale"] was "enormous", as the Nigerian pressed ahead with plans for a $16 billion refinery in Kenya that would extend his energy empire across Africa. Dangote, [USN:L6N43T0T2 TEXT:"Africa's richest man"], earlier this month launched a $1.6 billion initial public offering in the refinery to fund a doubling of its capacity to 1.4 billion barrels per day. The deal is being marketed as a "people's IPO" and would be Africa's largest. "Demand is there, enormous demand. In fact, I didn't know the depth of our capital markets until now, really, because we have never tested it," he told reporters in Nairobi. He did not provide specific investor demand figures for the offer, which is scheduled to close on October 13. The deal, which is [USN:L8N44F0H4 TEXT:"underwritten"] for $400 million by Dangote's lead financial advisers, could raise as much as $2.1 billion if oversubscribed. Strong demand has temporarily disrupted some financial technology platforms as investors rushed to buy into the refinery, which is widely viewed as a bet on Africa's need for greater refining capacity. "We expected a wave of retail demand in the IPO, but in reality, it's been more like a tsunami," Richmond Bassey, chief executive of Nigerian financial technology platform Bamboo, which focuses on retail investors, told Reuters. The platform registered a 350% surge in new accounts in the week before the IPO opened, a rate that was surpassed after the offer launched, he said. DANGOTE TO REPLICATE LAGOS FACILITY IN KENYA Construction of a 700,000 barrel-per-day refinery for the East African market, in which regional governments have been offered a 30% stake, is due to begin on Wednesday. The refinery near Kenya's second deep-water port of Lamu on the country's south coast is expected to cost $16 billion, Dangote said. Dangote said governments investing in the project, including Kenya and Rwanda, would be allowed to spread payments for their equity stakes over four years. "We have made it very simple and easy for them to fund their own equity. They are not putting their equity in one day," he said, adding Rwanda had sought a 10% stake, a request that is being discussed. Other countries besides Kenya and Rwanda have also expressed interest in investing in the refinery, Dangote said, without naming them. The Lamu refinery will source crude from regional producers, including Kenya, which is racing to begin oil production from its own deposits, as well as from overseas suppliers in the Middle East and the United States, Dangote said. "You don't go and build a refinery for only one source of crude. You take different types: Middle Eastern crude, American, WTI, so you mix them up," he said. The facility will also spur industries such as petrochemicals, Dangote said, adding pipelines would be built from the Lamu refinery into one or two countries in the region. He dismissed criticism of the project, including from conservationists and a group of local residents who have challenged it at Kenya's High Court, saying opposition was driven by traders whose businesses would be disrupted by the refinery. "Everybody is saying that 'no, we have a way that we used to make money without working hard.' But right now, they will make money still, but they have to work hard," he said.

item.title: Resurgent Brazil beat Australia 4-2 as muscle issue sidelines Raphinha
item.description: A second-half surge secured a 4-2 win for Brazil in their second friendly with Australia on Tuesday, but Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti was left worried as his captain Raphinha had to be substituted at halftime with muscle discomfort.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A second-half surge secured a 4-2 win for Brazil in their second friendly with Australia on Tuesday, but Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti was left worried as his captain Raphinha had to be substituted at halftime with muscle discomfort. The Brazilian federation (CBF) said Barcelona attacker Raphinha, who scored from the spot before the break to equalise at 2-2, felt discomfort in his right leg, where he has suffered multiple hamstring and thigh injuries. Raphinha's departure, however, did not hinder Brazil's comeback after a shaky first half, as Bruno Guimaraes struck in the 69th minute and Vinicius Jr converted a late penalty to secure their only win in the two-match friendly tour of Australia. Australia had fielded the same starting 11 that [USN:L6N45H0IP TEXT:"had Brazil on the ropes"] in Friday's 1-1 draw, but Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti made seven changes, switching out the entire defence. The pitchside fireworks before kickoff in Brisbane were no match for Brazil's immediate barrage, as Vanderson scored his first international goal just three minutes in. But Australia hit back from Connor Metcalfe's corner before the half-hour mark, as Alessandro Circati tapped home at the far post. Five minutes later, Metcalfe let fly a left-footer from outside the box that soared past the diving keeper, putting Australia ahead. Brazil equalised just before the break from Raphinha's penalty after Danilo was brought down by Harry Souttar. Raphinha's replacement Endrick immediately drew repeated harsh challenges from Souttar, nearly kicking off a brawl after Endrick pushed Souttar and went down grabbing his neck in the 65th minute. Endrick had his revenge four minutes later, as he sprinted down the left and flashed a cross to Guimaraes, who struck the ball in. Vinicius scored Brazil's fourth in the 80th minute with another penalty after Nestory Irankunda tripped him in the box. Brazil travel to Kolkata for a friendly with India on Saturday.

item.title: US CDC confirms two measles-related deaths in 2026
item.description: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on Tuesday confirmed a second measles-related death in the country this year, as cases continue to rise across the United States.
item.dc:creator: Siddhi Mahatole
item.content:encoded: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on Tuesday confirmed a second measles-related death in the country this year, as cases continue to rise across the United States. The confirmation, posted on the agency's website, did not specify in which states the deaths occurred but showed 3,659 measles infections in the US as of September 24. Pennsylvania, the hardest hit by the outbreak, [USN:L4N4571A0 TEXT:"reported"] four measles-related deaths this year, but the CDC had not included them in its national tally. The discrepancy has become the focus of a dispute between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and US health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. over whether deaths reported by the state should be counted in the federal tally. The CDC has shifted to using mortality data from the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) for its national measles death count, moving away from reliance on state health departments — drawing scrutiny. Amesh Adalja, a senior scholar at the Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security, said the gap between Pennsylvania's tally and the federal count risked undermining public confidence. "To the public, that gap looks like either incompetence or concealment," Adalja said, adding that it could give vaccine skeptics grounds to argue that the deaths were "invented or inflated." The US Department of Health and Human Services, which oversees the CDC, told Reuters that the NCHS had received another report from a state of a measles-related death and verified that measles was the underlying cause. Last week's [USN:L4N45F199 TEXT:"first confirmed fatality"] was similarly added after the NCHS verified that measles was listed as the underlying cause of death. The CDC has said it is working with state epidemiologists on a standard definition for measles-related deaths. The agency said its death count could change as additional information becomes available and reviews are completed.

item.title: Pistorius will 16 neue A400M-Transporter bei Airbus kaufen
item.description: Verteidigungsminister Boris Pistorius hat den Kauf von 16 neuen Transportflugzeugen des Typs Airbus A400M in Aussicht gestellt. Die Bundeswehr denke "sehr konkret" darüber nach, 16 ihrer bisherigen Maschinen, die nur für logistische Zwecke ausgelegt seien, durch neue, voll einsatzfähige taktische Flugzeuge zu ersetzen, sagte der SPD-Politiker am Dienstag am Rande eines Besuchs des Airbus-Werks in Bremen. Als Grund nannte er die veränderte Sicherheitslage. Die Kosten für die Neubeschaffung bezifferte er auf einen Milliardenbetrag. Der Bundesverband der Deutschen Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie (BDLI) begrüßte die Pläne. "Deutschlands Luftwaffe braucht eigene Flügel", sagte die Hauptgeschäftsführerin des Verbands, Marie-Christine von Hahn. Die Beschaffung würde die Einsatzfähigkeit der Bundeswehr stärken und sei ein wichtiges Signal für die europäische Industrie. Airbus selbst wollte sich auf Anfrage nicht äußern.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Verteidigungsminister Boris Pistorius hat den Kauf von 16 neuen Transportflugzeugen des Typs Airbus A400M (AIR.PA) in Aussicht gestellt. Die Bundeswehr denke "sehr konkret" darüber nach, 16 ihrer bisherigen Maschinen, die nur für logistische Zwecke ausgelegt seien, durch neue, voll einsatzfähige taktische Flugzeuge zu ersetzen, sagte der SPD-Politiker am Dienstag am Rande eines Besuchs des Airbus-Werks in Bremen. Als Grund nannte er die veränderte Sicherheitslage. Die Kosten für die Neubeschaffung bezifferte er auf einen Milliardenbetrag. Der Bundesverband der Deutschen Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie (BDLI) begrüßte die Pläne. "Deutschlands Luftwaffe braucht eigene Flügel", sagte die Hauptgeschäftsführerin des Verbands, Marie-Christine von Hahn. Die Beschaffung würde die Einsatzfähigkeit der Bundeswehr stärken und sei ein wichtiges Signal für die europäische Industrie. Airbus selbst wollte sich auf Anfrage nicht äußern. Die Bundeswehr verfügt derzeit über 53 Flugzeuge des Typs A400M. Davon seien jedoch 16 Maschinen nicht für den militärischen Einsatz im engeren Sinne ausgestattet, erklärte Pistorius. Ihnen fehlten beispielsweise Systeme zur Abwehr von Raketen. "Die aktuelle Sicherheitslage erfordert, dass wir das einmal überdenken", sagte der Minister. Mit dem Austausch der Flugzeuge würde die Einsatzbereitschaft der Luftwaffe "noch einmal deutlich erhöht". Vor einer endgültigen Entscheidung sei jedoch die Zustimmung des Bundestages erforderlich, betonte Pistorius. Zudem gebe es bei den laufenden Gesprächen mit Airbus noch Klärungsbedarf. Die Bundeswehr habe hohe Anforderungen an die Einsatzbereitschaft der Flugzeuge und klare Vorstellungen bezüglich der Betriebskosten. Sollte es zu dem Geschäft kommen, würden die 16 ausgemusterten Maschinen Partnerländern zum Kauf angeboten. Pistorius hob hervor, dass eine solche Bestellung zudem industrielle Kapazitäten und Arbeitsplätze am Standort Bremen und in Deutschland sichern würde. Der Minister lobte den A400M als "das beste Flugzeug seiner Art". Anfängliche "Kinderkrankheiten" seien überwunden. Weltweit flögen zehn Nationen mehr als 120 Maschinen dieses Typs.
